held_constant: Pinned public source cards, neutral question set/required IDs/revisions, model digest, temperature/seed/context/thread/output budget, fact schema/string bounds, frozen deterministic metadata/citation/FAQ reuse and unchanged acceptance protocol.
necessary_instruction_change: System/user instructions truthfully specify source extraction rather than supplied-fact copying. This is not an isolated one-field causal comparison.
gate_rule: Require unique-key JSON, exact complete required ID set, both original language strings within frozen length, all factual propositions manually source-reviewed, no critical unsupported addition, correct EN/PT meaning. Then copy original strings verbatim, attach frozen source citations/metadata, reuse generated faq_fact_id text. Refuse on any missing/false/unreviewed fact; never fill omitted text or repair outputs from references.
acceptance: Apply unchanged acceptance-protocol-v2 eleven dimensions to each fully assembled bounded bilingual source note. No independent human approval, Gold, active-catalog integration, general whole-chapter or trained-model improvement claim.
source_roles: Already development-exposed and training-excluded; no independent evaluation or optimizer/model-knowledge gain claim.
